ai_summary: ABM Knowledgeware Limited reported a 21% year-over-year increase in Q2 FY27 consolidated operational revenue to ₹26 crores, primarily driven by strong performance in its Digital Governance segment. However, overall profitability (7% Operating Profit Margin) was significantly impacted by strategic investments in the nascent Agritech business—for which specific financials are not disclosed, raising a transparency concern—and competitive pressures in the Cybersecurity segment. While the Cybersecurity unit posted a Q2 loss, this was attributed to a major customer's alternate billing cycle and offset by strong half-yearly growth, indicating a period of investment-led expansion with near-term margin pressure.
